Here we report the synthesis and mechanical properties of bulk NC W100-xTix (x = 10 at.%–30 at.%) alloys prepared by consolidating mechanically alloyed NC powders under a high-temperature/high-pressure condition.
Four W100-xTix (x = 0 at.%, 10 at.%, 20 at.%, and 30 at.%) materials were synthesized.
The starting materials were W (99.95% pure, 3 μm) and Ti (99.99% pure, 48 μm) powders.
